values.value: While I'm here — heads up, we're in peak Florida swarm season right now (March through May). Subterranean termites swarm after warm rain, and once they find a colony entry point it's a much bigger job. Our Termite Protection plan covers Sentricon bait stations plus a Termidor liquid barrier. Most homeowners on this block have one. Want me to get a free inspection on the calendar? Takes about 45 minutes, no obligation.
